GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF NORTH CAROLINA 
SESSION 2025 
S D 
SENATE BILL DRS15124-ML-84D  
 
 
 
Short Title: Utility Worker Protection Act. (Public) 
Sponsors: Senators Britt, Craven, and Blue (Primary Sponsors). 
Referred to:  
 
*DRS15124-ML-84D* 
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED 1 
AN ACT TO INCREASE THE PUNISHMENT FOR COMMITTING AN ASSAULT 2 
AGAINST A UTILITY OR COMMUNICATIONS WORKER. 3 
The General Assembly of North Carolina enacts: 4 
SECTION 1.  G.S. 14-33(b) reads as rewritten: 5 
"(b) Unless his the conduct is covered under some other provision of law providing greater 6 
punishment, any person who commits any assault, assault and battery, or affray is guilty of a 7 
Class 1 misdemeanor if, in the course of the assault, assault and battery, or affray, he:he or she 8 
does any of the following: 9 
… 10 
(9) Commits an assault and battery against a sports official when the sports 11 
official is discharging or attempting to discharge official duties at a sports 12 
event, or immediately after the sports event at which the sports official 13 
discharged official duties. A "sports official" is a person at a sports event who 14 
enforces the rules of the event, such as an umpire or referee, or a person who 15 
supervises the participants, such as a coach. A "sports event" includes any 16 
interscholastic or intramural athletic activity in a primary, middle, junior high, 17 
or high school, college, or university, any organized athletic activity 18 
sponsored by a community, business, or nonprofit organization, any athletic 19 
activity that is a professional or semiprofessional event, and any other 20 
organized athletic activity in the State. 21 
(10) Assaults a utility or communications worker while the worker is (i) readily 22 
identifiable as a worker and (ii) discharging or attempting to discharge his or 23 
her duties. For purposes of this subdivision, the term "utility or 24 
communications worker" means an employee of, agent of, or under contract 25 
with an organization, entity, or company, whether State-created or privately, 26 
municipally, county, or cooperatively owned, that provides electricity, natural 27 
gas, telecommunications services, or internet access services. For purposes of 28 
this subdivision, the term "readily identifiable as a worker" shall be construed 29 
to include the worker wearing, at the time of the assault , a uniform, hat, or 30 
other outerwear bearing the logo of the utility or communications company  31 
for which the worker is an employee of, agent of, or under contract with." 32 
SECTION 2.  Prosecutions for offenses committed before the effective date of this 33 
act are not abated or affected by this act, and the statutes that would be applicable but for this act 34 
remain applicable to those prosecutions. 35
